t: Destroy 4 Salt Deposits in Saltern. Report to Feodor Sonkin in the Coral Canyon.

The second part of my plan involves the salt itself. It can't be taken out of the sand, but we can destroy the large deposits that grow around here.
My orders are to pour this volatile mixture on the crystals. It will set them on fire and completely destroy them - they will be melted into oblivion!
The operation begins now! Well, what are you standing there for? I did say go! Don't you like watching things burn?
Now even the sources of the salt will be destroyed. My plan will leave them without any options!
Again - an undisputable success. The mafia has now suffered serious losses.
Tell Feodor Sonkin about the courier's information.

Wait! I have the keys - how about I give them to you, and you let me go. No? What do you want, information? Okay... Well, Victor Korleone is the boss around here, he has hundreds of salt gatherers working for him.
You knew that already? Oh. Well, he's also the mafia's Godfather! You knew that too? No, don't do that! I can tell you more, I promise!
His goal is to seize power throughout the Empire! Yes! And he could do it too with the refined sea salt that he's made. It forces all who take it to depend on him, even the most powerful, independent, and proud!
They will do everything that he tells them to. Absolutely everything! If he tells them to jump off an allod into the Astral - then they will jump.
Those who take the salt become stupid, true, but to gain power all he needs are sheer numbers. A large shipment of refined salt is about to be sent into the capital. He will conquer the entire Empire, like he conquered the Dead Sea. That's all. Can I run away now?

Courier from the Godfather himself? Why have you apprehended and questioned him alone?! Why do you think we are here, eh?
Alright, what did you get out of him?
Don't worry, we were deployed here specifically to nip any coups in the bud!
Find a clue on the source of the undead and report to Sika the Nimble.

Wait! You're not a Hawk, but you are an Imperial citizen. I am ordering you to help me out here. My current mission is to destroy the undead in the desert, and to find out where they come from. Commander Sonkin suspects that it has something to do with the mafia, but we're really not sure.
I can't do this alone, and it's doubtful that I'll be given backup. The commander and all the other Hawks are too busy right now. But the orders must be carried out regardless of the situation! You must do your duty to your country and help me solve this mystery.
I don't know if I'll be able to figure out this mystery. It might just be unsolvable, but I'm sure Commander Sonkin won't like that answer.
How curious... Shall we read it?
Deliver Strina the Fierce's letter to Wrokag the Northwind.

Let's see.
As far as I can tell, this is a letter from an Orc named Strina the Fierce and it's addressed to Wrokag.
Hmm, what nonsense is this? This Orcish woman is claiming to have the ability to do higher magic, saying that it was she who summoned the undead!
She says that it was merely a test of her strength. I have a hard time believing this! That kind of power is beyond us Orcs. Maybe this letter is a prank? Let me keep reading... She says that she changed her mind about returning to Wrokag, and that she doesn't trust Wrokag. She says she wants to walk her own path, and that Wrokag can go to... err, let's skip that part.
Bah, what utter drivel! She says that as proof of her power she was having a skeleton deliver the letter to Wrokag for her.
Well, she should have seen this coming - if not you, then someone else would have surely killed her bony courier before it got to Nezebgrad. Commander Sonkin will laugh if I tell him this stuff.
I'll just say that the threat was eliminated and I couldn't figure out where they came from. As far as the letter goes, I suppose it should be delivered to Wrokag immediately. Please give it to him the next time you're in Nezebgrad.
Did you find Strina? The hopes of all Orcs now rest with her!
What's this? A letter? Let me read it... May she be torn to pieces by demons! Foolish woman! How dare she! She cares nothing for the rest of us Orcs! She cares nothing for our freedom! Curse her!
Talk to Mikhail Korleone at the Seventh Seabed Resort.

It seems that it shall soon be time to begin the third phase of the plan. All targets beyond Laguna Boil have been destroyed. I have put all of the Hawks on full alert, and soon we shall strike at the head of the beast!
There is only one problem - we need a way to get into the dome. Those keys from the courier are useful, but there aren't enough of them for all of our forces.
Go and notify Mikhail Korleone immediately about this problem. Ask if any progress has been made in infiltrating Laguna Boil. Tell him that we need to act as soon as possible.
And don't waste any time in completing this mission. My boys have been climbing the walls from boredom.
It is good to know that we'll soon be able to launch the final stage of the plan. But first I need to have a conversation with you about something very sensitive...
Go to Laguna Boil and use the Psi-Emitter on Viktor Korleone to kill him.

Viktor Korleone may be my father, but I don't feel sorry for him for a second! He's responsible for creating thousands of sea salt addicts, killing hundreds of people in mafia wars, and many other crimes. And my mother... I never found out exactly how she died. I have my suspicions... but no, I can't talk about that. It hurts too much.
My father deserves to die. The only thing that I wish for him is that he dies quickly and from my own hand. Besides, I believe that it is my responsibility to end the pain that has lasted for centuries.
Alas, I do not have a tenth of the strength necessary to confront my father. That is why I must ask you for a favor. Will you be my tool of revenge and act in my place?
But I must warn you, my father is a very powerful psionicist. He is capable of casting the most destructive mental spells and preventing all damage from being done to him.
Fortunately I can do a little bit to help you. You can use this special Psi-Emitter on my father during the battle. It shall allow me to enter his brain and disrupt his thoughts. While he is distracted, he will let his barrier down and then you will be able to kill him. Good luck!
I have been saving that device for many years, waiting for the chance to strike at my father.

I'm still a little dizzy from my efforts. I consider myself lucky that I even survived. You did a great job out there, I shall be forever grateful to you!
Now everything is over. The shadow that lay over my family has been lifted, and the Empire has been saved!
Use the Enchanted Spirit Staff to turn into a scorpion, infiltrate Laguna Boil, switch off the generators, find the key, and report to Sarang Eshe.

Do you remember how the snakes managed to crawl inside the dome? Well, I studied them, and the answer was ridiculously simple - the dome only blocks intelligent creatures. Any of the lesser beings can pass right through, great or small!
So, how do you feel about scorpions? I hope you don't hate them too much, because to infiltrate Victor Korleone's lair you'll have to become one.
By using the essence of the Scorpion King, I was able to modify the Spirit Staff so that it will transform you into one of the creatures. The only catch is that the effects last for a short time.
Activate the staff close to the normal entrance to Laguna Boil. There the magic is the weakest, and you will be able to crawl inside without any trouble.
After you get in, the first thing you must do is switch off the generators that create the magical dome. Then the Yasker Hawks will rush in and help you fight the criminals.
What else can I say, except may your path be filled with the Light! Even though I don't really believe in all that religious nonsense, a blessing never goes astray!
Don't worry, I'm sure that you won't be stuck as a scorpion! That is, if you collected the essence of the Scorpion King correctly.
Well done, you completed the operation perfectly! Oh, I am so happy that the days of the mafia will soon be over. Then my baby can expand his roots and the desert will become lush again!
Kill 4 Criminal Cutthroats and return to Alexey Sinitsyn.

Are you heading off to Laguna Boil? Well then, our time together is coming to an end. It has certainly been a pleasure to work with you. I have met few people that can carry out missions with such precision and such speed.
And this shall be the last task I give you - beat those monsters to a pulp for enslaving innocent Imperial citizens! Give them one more lesson to make them sorry for what they've done, and maybe, just maybe Tensess will forgive them if they do. I can't say that I will do the same.
I believe that there are many of them inside Laguna Boil that have not yet felt the Council's wrath. Return to me after their blood stains the sand.
It's in times like this that I feel sad that I became a spy, not a soldier! What a pity that I can't help you.

Ah, beating up those criminals would have been fun. But then everyone has a job to do. I think and analyze - you kill! Everyone is a professional in their field. Take this last reward and remember me when you wear them.
Report everything that happened in the Dead Sea to Yasker.

There is one last matter to be taken care of. That is the subject of those voices that you heard when you took the psi-salt cube. The... you know... the stuff about Nezeb...
I can't say it! Even the walls have ears. This isn't something we can discuss aloud. Thank the Light that my family is no longer involved in any of this. Go to the capital as soon as you can and report everything to Yasker. To say that this is a matter of state interest doesn't even begin to describe it!

Power gained through force can be attractive, but I am not Korleone. I do not believe that gaining power through force is the right thing to do. And I will never become the monster that Korleone's deluded addicts believed me to be.
Unfortunately, politics can be dirty work sometimes. But does it really matter how all things are accomplished? Look at the history of any civilization and you will find wars, crimes, and madness.
Perhaps the results are more important? If our citizens are happy, if they are proud of their country, if they look to the future with hope? We have built a strong Empire, and the citizens are reciprocating with love and loyalty. That is what's important.
What happened out there will be kept completely secret, like all reports about the operation in the Dead Sea. Those psi-salt cubes never existed, and may this all be buried right now.
Take this. I want you to know that I am not trying to buy your silence, for I am already convinced of your loyalty. This is the least I can do to thank you for what you've done.
Find the history books or documents in the Korleones' library.

Do you remember that glass orb from the ship? I spent some time studying it and I found out that the artifact used to contain great power. So much power that if it was released, it would have caused the death of all living creatures for miles around. And I suspect that this is indeed what happened.
Mikhail mentioned that there is a large library in Laguna Boil which belongs to his family. The Korleone family has inhabited this region for generations, so if anyone had more information on the orb it would be them.
Perhaps when you go to Laguna Boil you can search the library for any information that could unravel this mystery. The secret might be more important than we can guess.
There is a book among the piles that is titled "The History of the Dead Sea". Despite its age, it looks to be in pristine condition. The Korleone's certainly took good care of their stuff.
Bring the History of the Dead Sea to Sarang Eshe.

Korleone Chronicles are of great interest for us. According to the book, it was the Korleone family who discovered the mystery of sea salt that, being exposed to sulfuric fumes deep in the ocean, transformed into a hard drug, a psi-salt. In dishonest hands it could be used as a means of mind suppression. And that was the starting moment of the Korleone family's rise.
Fancy that, Nezeb himself supported the psi-salt production! He invented new methods that allowed the Empire to add psi-salt to fresh water, and make all its citizen be proud of and loyal to their country.
After the Cataclysm, the sea drastically changed, there were no more sulfuric vapors. Psi-salt no longer could be obtained. Therefore Nezeb ordered to cover all the tracks and kill the sailors. It appears that the orb caused the deaths of many of them thousands of years ago. Perhaps the spirits in Baladur port were victims of this tragedy? What a horrible way to die!
Sarang Eshe would certainly love to read this book herself. It contains tons of other information on psi-salt and the history of the Dead Sea, in addition to chronicling the secret of the orb. This is one of the most important historical finds in decades.
Well? Did you find anything out about the orb?

Wow! Look at this! I never imagined such a wealth of information existed. I must read this entire thing immediately as soon as all of the action dies down. Here, take one of these rewards. And thank you again!
Bring 4 Scorpion Mandibles to Lieutenant Rodion Borodin.

Welcome to one of the farthest ends of the Empire! As you can see, once upon a time there was a sea here. But after the Great Cataclysm - that was it! All of the water poured straight into Astral, never to be seen again! Now all that's left is salt, sand, and the bones of ancient sea creatures.
The sand always gets everywhere, you know, and the salt constantly erodes the soles of our shoes. That's something you're just going to have to get used to around here. And make sure to watch out for the various vermin. They seem to flourish around here.
By the way, if you want to make some money I can point you in the right direction. My commander, Lieutenant Bodrin, has put a bounty on the scorpions around here. Just bring him some proof of your deeds and he'll reward you handsomely. You can find him right outside the large blue dome to the east - it's huge, you can't miss it.
The Lieutenant always hangs out around there. I'm sure he's trying to crack the mystery of how to get in. Hah! Everybody knows you need special connections to manage that. He should just give up.
Yeah, the scorpions are a local plague. When you go to sleep, you don't know whether or not you'll wake up in the morning! Those creatures might get you.
One mandible - one dead creature. Ten mandibles - ten creatures. It warms my heart to see these!
Bring the Archeologist's Papers and the Archeologist's Backpack to Sarbaz Hsekiu.

Dry sands. A hot sun. Stupid birds. That's all there is in this cursed place! Damnit all! Hm, pardon me for being so emotional. It's just that I'm stuck here and it's quite irritating.
You see, I came here with an expedition to survey the dig site at Baladur Port. On the way there, I got a little distracted when I was studying some ruins. When I looked up, everyone else in the expedition was gone! I was left behind!
Then things just got even worse. A whole bunch of vultures attacked me and I had to flee for my life. Along the way I dropped my backpack and I have no idea where it is. All of my stuff's in it - my diplomas, documents, recommendations! It even has my identification papers!
As I was running away I saw one of those horrible birds fly overhead with pieces of yellow paper in his beak. Those must have been my papers... Without them, people won't believe me when I tell them I'm a scientist - something about being too fussy. In any case, I can't go anywhere until I find my stuff. I'm stuck!
Damn the day I agreed to join this expedition! When I think of my cozy crypt back home - dry, gloomy, a mouse squeaking in the corner... Oh, I miss it so!

My bag! My papers! Thank you so much! I can now go on my way again. Oh, I do want to head home, but I know that the greatest historical discoveries are made in the field. I guess it's off to the port for me.
Bring 4 Sea Salt Crystals to Konk the Rowdy.

Ah, I see that familiar sparkle in your eyes. I'm guessing you're also after some fast money. That's what most people are here for. On the bottom of the sea, the desert dwellers will pay you well to do their dirty work. You can get three years pay in twelve months!
I've already finished my job here. I was working on over at the Meteorite Mines. That's one of the best places to go. Now I'm going home to my wife and kids with a whole bag of gold!
There's just one problem. I must have caught some nasty bug down in those mines. I'm coughing all over the place. Don't worry, it's not contagious and it's easily treated. Just a few sea salt crystals would fix me right up!
It's all over the desert, but right now I don't have the strength to go out and get it. Do you think you could do me a favor and bring me some? Just four pieces would fix me right up! Please - don't let my children die of hunger! They need their father! You'll help me, won't you?
I'm pretty sure it's a rare illness. Who knows what it's called? And I'm sure that only the sea salt can save me!
Crystals! Pass them here, quickly! Ooh... that's better.
Meet Yuri Boklov at the security entrance, find Lieutenant Rodion Borodin by the magical dome in the Dead Sea and learn how to get to the resort.

By the way, how do you feel? I'm sure you're pretty tired from all of that work. Let me tell you a little secret. There is a very interesting place where you can go and relax. I'm talking about the "Seventh Seabed Resort".
You see, deep in the wretched desert is hidden one of the most precious pearls of the Empire. It is surrounded by a large magical dome, and very few people know what goes on inside. Now you are one them.
Take this medallion. It doesn't look like much, but it's your pass into a little piece of paradise. Go east across the Igsh Military District. There is a road you can follow that runs parallel to some mana pipes and into the Dead Sea. You must meet Yuri Boklov and check in at the security entrance.
Proceed to the middle of the desert, and you will see a large magical dome. Outside is a man named Lieutenant Rodion Borodin. He is one of our people, and once you show him the medallion he will give you further instructions.
I don't have to remind you to keep this a secret, do I?

Oh, you want to go to the Seventh Seabed Resort? Have you been warned about the need for secrecy? Good! I'm practically the only person on this side of the dome that knows anything about it, and I intend for it to stay that way.

The resort is under this smaller dome here. There is also a much larger dome to the north, but that is not a place for vacationers. Make sure not to mix them up! Do you have the special medallion? Good. You can't get in without it. Pass it here, I will activate it for you.
Talk to Mikhail Korleone in the Seventh Seabed Resort.

The Seventh Seabed Resort is supposed to be a paradise in the desert. Unfortunately, I haven't been there myself. According to my orders I can only guard it, and I don't have permission to get inside. How I would love to be in there, for even one second...
Gah, this heat is scorching! And nothing but sand and vile creatures for as far as the eye can see. I bet inside the dome it's cool and lush. Maybe if I do a good job I'll get a promotion and be invited inside.
Yes, I'm chatting too much aren't I. You want to get inside immediately. You're so lucky! Here's your medallion, now you can walk into the dome through any of the three entrances. When you get inside report to the resort director Mikhail Korleone. He will be responsible for you during your stay.
Ok, that's it, go now. I can't look at you anymore, you're making me so jealous.

Aha, the medallion! Then you have full rights to be here. Welcome to the Resort! Only those closest to... I mean to say, only the most deserving citizens of the Empire receive permission to come here.
Well, I guess you've earned this for your heroic achievements. Even I have heard about them, so there's no question that you're deserving!
Kill 4 Paradise Adders and return to Mikhail Korleone.

Relax, work on your tan, and enjoy the greenery. This is paradise, you know! You won't get bored here, I promise - you can always go for a walk, make new friends, hang out with your companions, and sleep your troubles away.
There's only one tiny problem, to be honest. Those snakes! This is meant to be a paradise, the opposite of what's outside the dome. I don't know how they got in here and they're ruining the scenery. Those snakes better not cost us our paradise!
Fortunately, they seem to be pretty docile. no one's been bitten yet, but it's still concerning... Well, of course I won't insist on anything, but if you would like to stretch your legs and go hunting - those reptiles make great targets! Well, that's all I wanted to say.
These snakes are a blot among this perfection!
Can you see now? Paradise is what we create ourselves. That's the moral of this story. Thanks to you, there are now less snakes in this dome.
Release earthworms in 4 piles of Moist Soil. Then report to Sarang Eshe.

All of these people are sitting here in paradise without a care for anything but themselves. Oh, the living are so selfish! This place should be a paradise for everything inside, but I feel like I'm the only one who cares about this. Or perhaps not the only one? Maybe you're concerned about this too?
You see, I'm worried about this tiny tree growing in the center of the dome. Yes, it is a Great Tree, but it's still just a baby. And how do you think it feels, growing in a thin layer of imported soil, surrounded by sand and salt? Not much of a paradise if you ask me!
Here's what I'm thinking of doing - we could release some earthworms into the soil around its roots. They might loosen up the ground and make it easier for the baby to grow. Will you help me out? Here's the box of worms you need. I'd help you out myself, but I've only got one box. I can't figure out where I put the second one...

I may be undead, but even I fry in this heat.
Everyone will win if we could turn the Dead Sea into a flowering garden.
I can already tell by the sound of its branches that the baby is happy. Thank you so much, from me and the tree!
Use the amulet to charge 4 Generators, then return to Jukat the Nomadic.

Hello!
Are you relaxing, enjoying yourself? Good! It's my job to protect all of the people inside the dome. This thing is the pinnacle of engineering design, you know! It's maintained by generators around the entire perimeter.
My helper is a great guy, also an Orc, but he never really got proper schooling. He has plenty of strength, but no brains. I'm afraid to trust him with the generators, and it's time to charge them up. But you look like a smart person, and I'm sure you'd be able to manage the job. I know you came here to relax, but this will make things much smoother for the rest of your stay, I promise!
Can you do this for me? Here's a special tool, just use it on the generators and everything should be a-okay!

If the generators aren't charged up in time, the dome will disappear and the sands will swallow this place up. Not to mention that all of those creepy-crawlies would get in here too!
Our paradise would be ruined!
Have all generators been charged up? Excellent! Enjoy the rest of your stay! Sorry I distracted you.
Bring 160 Centipede Legs to Alexey Sinitsyn.

What a fight that was, I still tremble when I remember it! I don't know what those Kanian generals were thinking. What fools, they should have never attempted to invade Nezebgrad!
I'm talking about the recent fight off the coast of Severny Steppe! I was at the helm of the "Irrefutable", you know. My exploits were written about in the newspapers, haven't you read about them? What a pity, you should have. And now here I am, enjoying my well-deserved rest.
This is a good spot for fishing, as expected of a true paradise! My bait is all used up though. I had a box of worms that I found lying around, but there were only a few in there. Now they're all gone.
Hey, are you going outside any time soon? They say that the local carp like centipede legs. Can you bring me some so I can try them out?
Here fishy fishy fishy... Nope, I definitely can't catch any without the proper bait.
Hmm, do you think the fish will bite with these on my hook? I really hope so. Thanks for your help.
Visit the archeological expedition in Baladur Port, kill 4 ghosts, then speak to Yasskul Ankhtifi.

Like any self-respecting resort, we are offering a wide range of tours to our visitors. What would you say about touring the ruins of an ancient Xadaganian port?
A thousand years ago it was full of life - ships berthed at the docks, beams squeaked, dock workers practiced and invented complex linguistic expressions... The people are long gone, but you could enjoy looking at the remnants of the ships. Are you interested?
There's an archaeological dig not far from the port, and I would recommend visiting them if you want an in-depth glimpse into history. I heard they're having some problems with the sailors' spirits, though. I guess it's the difference in attitudes. It has been over a thousand years!
But remember, if you're going to visit the archaeologists don't tell them that you are from the Resort. The true purpose of the dome must remain secret. Introduce yourself as an Imperial Sentinel, curious about everything around you.
Make sure to seem genuine, hmm... I know, you could try killing a few spirits. It would help the archaeologists and your story would be more fleshed out.
What are you doing at this dig?! Stop! Don't move! There could be an ancient bit of pottery under any grain of sand. This area is very fragile!
Ah, you're from the Imperial Sentinels. The Empire looks after her own even on the bottom of the sea. This is commendable.
Search the Fallen Spirits for 3 Ancient Ship Logs and bring them to Yasskul Ankhtifi.

We desperately need your help! It's impossible to work in these conditions. The spirits of ancient sailors are everywhere. I can't sleep at night - there's shouting, swearing, clunking of empty rum bottles. And just to make it crazier, every midnight from that ship over there a spirit shouts "Island ahead! Island!"
But that isn't the biggest problem. These spirits are aggressive, and they're not allowing us near the ships. Thankfully we haven't had many conflicts yet. After all we are scientists, not warriors, and we keep our distance. But now all our work has come to a dead halt.
I'm sure that we're the first expedition to come to this region, which means this area is still full of artifacts. Search those spirits for anything useful that they have. They won't be needing them anymore. I just know that the Sentinels won't leave Imperial scientists without help, right?
For the basis for my doctoral thesis, I'm going to use the information from the ships' logs. What a brilliant idea!

Hmm... the pages are all stuck together with salt. And they're hard as a rock! There's no way I can read this. I guess I'll have to come up with a new plan.
In any case, thank you for your help. The Empire can rest peacefully, secure in the knowledge that it's protected by brave Sentinels!
Attempt to control 4 ghosts with the Blood-infused Amulet, then report to Marianna Lopatina.

I don't think those fallen sailors pose a difficulty to our research. They're living history! These people saw our world as it was a thousand years ago! Can you imagine that? Just the thought of it makes me dizzy!
But how to talk to them, that is the main question... Judging by what we know, they became spirits sometimes around the time of the Great Cataclysm. But that doesn't necessarily mean they died as a result of it. To make that assumption would be very narrow-minded.
You see, here are two things that can cause a soul to linger in this world. When they die before their time, or when a necromancer rips the soul out of their body with dark magic. Due to their level of agitation, I think that perhaps the latter is what happened to those sailors! And I think I know how I can prove this theory.
I have an old amulet that I found in some past expedition. It was used by an ancient Zem necromancer to perform such rituals. Try using its power on a few spirits - if any of them respond to the magic and start to obey you, then my theory must be correct.
Of course it's interesting to study old ships and bits of pottery, but we must study the spirits first!

Not a single spirit obeyed you? I must have made a mistake then. They can't have been killed by a necromancer.
I wonder what happened here that killed all those brave sailors?
Bring 4 Pieces of Ancient Wood to Sarang Eshe.

Even the air is permeated with salt. Can you feel it? No? Well, my baby can! I noticed it on his skin... I mean, bark... some strange salt growths, areas where salt has penetrated into his trunk.
What'll happen if the salt penetrates further and further, straight into his core... Oh, how my dead heart aches at the thought. I just can't let that happen!
We need to find out for sure what this salt can do to wood. They say that there are old ships around Baladur Port, and that their sides have been exposed to salt for more than a thousand years. That's an excellent place for me to begin my research. Please bring me four samples of this salted wood from the ships.
I've already treated baby's trunk and scrubbed off all the salt deposits. Unfortunately, there's no guarantee that this won't happen again...
Oh my goodness! Is this wood or a large salt crystal? I can't tell the difference! Just look at what the Dead Sea air can do!
Bring 4 Snake Eggs to Jukat the Nomadic.

I'm so fed up with trivial complaints! My job is to look after the dome and make sure it works. Just yesterday Sarang Eshe came to me and complained that snakes are able to sneak into the dome from the outside!
And what do I care? Is the dome still present? Yes. Is it still working properly? Yes! Don't ask me how the snakes are getting in - ask the engineers who designed this dome. I don't know who they were, but I'm sure they were paid very well for their work. Blast these whiners!
If Sarang Eshe wants to solve this mystery so badly, she can take a look at the snakes herself and figure out why they're impervious to the dome's magic. Or she can do anything with them that she likes, it's really none of my concern. Myself, I could write a complaint to the capital about the issue, but this problem is technically not mine.
If you care about it, then bring me some snake eggs that I can give the Arisen to study. The snakes in the dome haven't been here long enough to breed, but there should be a whole bunch of eggs near their kin to the south.
The snakes must have crawled in through the dome wall. All newcomers are thoroughly searched so they couldn't have had them in their luggage.
Aha, once I give these things to Sarang Eshe I'm sure she'll stop annoying me. It's not my fault that these snakes are so sneaky.
Bring the Skull of an Ancient Fish to Alexey Sinitsyn.

Amazing! These carp adore centipede legs! What a pity that there is only one little lake. I bet this area was once full of tons of wonderful fish! You're a land lubber, and I'm sure you don't understand, but when the Dead Sea was still alive there were some fascinating species here.
I once found the remains of a huge crosspyterian fish, but there were snakes all around it! They were like creatures from a nightmare. I've been terrified of snakes since my childhood, they give me the shakes!
Hey, I was thinking, how great would it be if I had the head of that fish! I could go back to my ship, hang it up on the captain's bridge, and make the entire Imperial fleet green with envy. What do you think? I hope you're not scared of snakes? Can you bring me this head? I'll reward you well for your efforts!

They say that the captain of the "Astral Destroyer" used to have the skull of an ancient fish hanging in his cabin, but someone threw a chair at it in a drunken rage and it shattered to pieces! It turned out it used to be made of plaster! What a scoundrel. I will find myself a real head.
Look at that ugly face! You and I are the first people in all of Sarnaut to see such a beast, no doubt about it.
Kill 4 Mutant Crabs at the Mana Station. Report to Jackboot the Bloodthirsty.

Come here! Look at the back of my head - is there anything weird there? Be honest! Nothing? Phew. With the way the creatures around here have been mutating, I'm worried I might have grown a third eye or something.
I reckon all of this is because of that dang mana pipeline. It seems to be humming more lately, but no one tells me anything around here. So now I'm thinking - maybe my health is more important than this job?
They pay me well, feed me, and I used to have nothing to complain about. But this Astral energy is nothing but trouble I tell you! Just have a look at the poor crabs over there! What if I turn into something like that?
Recently my bosses gave me the order to destroy all of the mutants. Instead of fixing the problem, they just ask me - why are there so many mutants left? I'm the only guard here - how am I supposed to kill all of the new ones that appear? Hey, how about you help me kill some of those crabs. I'd give you part of my paycheck if you did!
Just be careful when you wave your sword close to that pipe! I can't imagine what would happen if it cracked!
Ooh, what's that on the back of your head? A third eye?? Hahaha... I'm kidding, I'm kidding, don't be angry. Here's your payment.
Find the potential mutants to the northeast of the Mana Station.

I've seen many bizarre things during my patrols. But some of the strangest had two legs! They look kind of like people, but they're very odd - empty eyes and frothing mouths. I don't know if they're mutants and whether or not they have to be destroyed...
Can you go and have a look at them, just in case? Ugh, this is the last thing I need! They shuffled off somewhere to the northeast, and I doubt they went very far.
Fif... fifteen men on... on a de... dead man's che... chest... Yohoho and a booo... bottle of rum... hey...! Who are you?
Ask Mikhail Korleone about the sea salt the deranged tourist was talking about.

Argh! Now I'm back here again... here... on the seabed... on this disgusting seabed... No, I don't want this! I need to go back to my happy place! You! Do you have salt? Salt?? Give me some to lick, gimme, gimme! Salt... I need... SALT! Argh!
Korleone is a monster! I hate him, oooh, I hate him so much! I want to kill him, he'll be covered in blood! I hate that sea salt, too, but I love it so much! I love that "white death"!
Korleone has great salt, it's really strong... ooh, it takes you straight to your happy place, yes it does. And then there's no more of this disgusting seabed. I need to get more. Can you help me...? Please? I WANT IT!

Why such an angry face? What happened?
Ah, it's about time! We placed bets on how long it would take you to discover the truth, you know. Well, let's have a serious discussion.
Agree to help Mikhail Korleone with his struggle against the "white death".

There's a reason why the salt around here is called the "white death" - it'll completely warp your brain. And even in its raw, unrefined state it's addictive. Our family has been trafficking it for hundreds of years now. My ancestors used to extract it from the salt water, but now it's a lot easier since the water is gone.
Don't look at me like that! I haven't finished yet. My father, Victor Korleone, is the one behind all this. He's a father not only to me, but also to many criminals and murderers. Unfortunately he is my real father, but to them he's just... a godfather.
The mafia's headquarters are located in the big dome to the north, called Laguna Boil. It was his name that the tourist was screaming. I suppose it's my name too, but I'm on the other side! I dream of the day that the "white death" will be no more.
I am ashamed of my family. I allied with the City Council and we built this dome to be our headquarters. We plan to destroy the mafia and plant forests all over this desert. The tree roots will then absorb the sea salt and process it, leaving no traces of that evil substance.
All of the inhabitants here are secretly part of this mission. Even Sinitsyn, as good as he is at pretending to be a ship captain. Would you like to join us in our mission?

I didn't doubt for a moment that you'd make the right choice!
Now, there is much work to be done. We need to mobilize all of our resources and act quickly. And this is for you - arm yourself for the coming battles.
Bring 4 pieces of Desert Tortoise Meat to Yaver Menhet.

So, are you with us in our battle? That's great - there's a mountain of work to do. The Great Tree is growing new shoots and soon it'll be time for us to expand.
We're beginning to build a new generator to the south of here, and we've code named the area Sector 05. The workers are pretending to be expanding the mana pipelines, but in fact we're getting ready to steal another piece of the desert and turn it into a paradise. Isn't that clever?
I need you to head on out there. The overseer is complaining that something odd has happened. I'm not surprised about that, for we employed goblins to do most of the labor. It seems there are always problems when they're around. Oh yes, and can you hunt some tortoises on the way there? We feed the meat to our workers.
Are you from the Resort? It's about time. I really need proper help right now, something those goblins can't provide!
Pass the meat over here. While my workers are eating, we can have a good talk.
Bring 4 pieces of Sea Salt to Yaver Menhet in Sector 05.

Someone is deliberately sabotaging the construction of the new dome, digging holes under the foundations and stealing our supplies. I posted guards.
But this morning we found more materials missing. The goblin that was on guard duty swore that everything was quiet the whole night. He did look like he hadn't slept in a while, so he must have been watching... but I seriously doubt that he saw nothing.
Fortunately, when you're a Psionicist everything is much easier. Especially in shady areas like the Dead Sea.
Salt! If I swallow only a few crystals, it'll sharpen my senses. Then I should be able to read a mind like an open book.
That guard won't be able to hide anything from me! Bring me four crystals, okay?
This goblin's eyes weren't just sleepy, but very very sneaky too. I'll show him to hide the truth from the overseer!
Just what I need. Now to begin the inspection!
Kill the Goblin Sentry and return to Jukat the Nomadic.

Ugh... I always feel a little weird after taking salt. Give me a minute... Okay. Now, let me focus my thoughts. Aha, so that's why he was so quiet about it, the sneak! The saboteurs are his brothers - fellow goblins.
They're probably related to the goblins from Nezebgrad that sabotaged the XAES. Their kind is full of all sorts of riff-raff, but they proudly pretend to be freeing themselves from tyranny! Hah! They're so pathetic - poor, disorganized creatures, not wanted by anybody.
Report everything we've learned to Jukat at the Resort. Wait, don't run away yet! There's still the matter of that traitorous sentry. I'm just an overseer, it's your job to get your hands bloody! Take him out before you go!
Hold your friends close, and goblins even closer. Pathetic traitors!
Aha, so it is those damned goblins that are sabotaging our operation! I should have known!
You won't take me down without a fight!
Kill 4 Salt Collectors in Sector 05. Report to Alexey Sinitsyn at the resort.

I kidded you a little... don't be upset with me, hehe. In any case, I do love fishing and that big head will come in useful. The only thing is - it won't be decorating the captain's bridge, but my office at the City Council! And I'll still make my coworkers green with envy!
But let's talk about work. To the south of Sector 05 is a large goblin encampment. The salt deposits form right on the surface there, and you can just take a spade and gather it up. That's the whole purpose of the camp, you see - they collect the stuff and then sell the raw salt in bulk to the Godfather.
Help us put an end to this dirty work for the good of the Empire. I am giving you the task of weeding out these scavengers.
By killing those goblins, we attack the root of the Godfather's network.

Each time you killed a goblin you saved the lives of ten innocent people.
You did a noble thing.
Blow up the stash of salt in the goblin encampment south and report to Alexey Sinitsyn.

It's not enough to simply destroy the scavengers. If we kill ten today, they'll all be replaced within a month. The rabble from the wastes are always happy to do this work. It's the highest paying job their kind is offered.
Deep in the goblin encampment you should find where they stockpile the salt. They only ship it off to the Godfather every couple of weeks, and I'd guess that right about now their stash is quite huge.
Take this magic mine that the Arisen scientists created for the Council. Set it next to their stores and run. It should set them back quite a bit and teach them a good lesson. Of course, I doubt you'll be able to make it to their stash without a good fight, but you must be used to fighting by now.
Am I imagining something, or did I just hear a far off explosion?
Aha, see what a great sense of hearing I've got! Excellent work! The Council is pleased to grant you a reward. Carry it with pride.
Talk to Karina Merinova at the Meteorite Mine.

The first task I have for you is pretty urgent. There's a small mine to the east of here, and it's been supplying meteorite ore for many centuries. By now its resources are pretty much exhausted, but in the Empire every crumb of this metal is worth its weight in gold. That's why the mine hasn't been closed yet.
And even though the Dead Sea is a troubled region, the mine is well guarded and works efficiently. It worked, that is... until recently.
Now I'm hearing gossip from there that I'm even scared to tell you about it. There's no point spooking you before we find out what really happened. Let's just hope the news is wrong.
Head on over there and talk with Karina Merinova, the overseer of this mine. Find out the truth and see if they need your help to correct any problems.
It's crazy here. The miners have gone nuts and many guards have been killed! Any extra pairs of hands are more valuable than gold!
Kill 4 Disoriented Miners and report to Karina Merinova.

They haven't simply lost their senses! This is political sabotage, a secret conspiracy against the Empire! And here I am in the thick of it all. What am I suppose to do?! Write a report to the City Council first? Or perhaps destroy the rebels immediately? I don't know, there was nothing like this in my job description!
What happened? What do you mean, what happened? Haven't I told you yet? The miners completely lost their minds and started killing anyone who tried to calm them down. Now they walk around with a crazy look in their eyes, yelling out nonsensical words.
Some of them are even insisting... oh, I can't bear to say it. They say that... that the current government is full of criminals who have usurped power. They are insisting that Nezeb himself is alive and will return soon to kill Yasker because... because he is an insolent pretender. They say that all his followers, including you and I, deserve to die.
Death, death to those insolent miners! Who will blame me for issuing orders to destroy them? Betrayers of the Empire and Yasker must die! Forward! That is, down! Down into the mine!

Yasker is Nezeb's successor, he is the father of the Empire!
Death to the rebels!

The miners are dead? How am I supposed to include that in my report?! Maybe I was a bit too hasty... Well, thank you for your help. Maybe I should try that salt cube... I could really use something to soothe my nerves right now.
What? It's dangerous? Well, you sound like you know better, so I guess I'll believe you. I've never tried the stuff myself. Here, take it and do whatever you want with it.
Show the Salt Cube to Mikhail Korleone.
It's a small cube of sea salt. It appears to be highly concentrated and has a slightly different color from normal sea salt. This should be shown to Mikhail Korleone as fast as possible.
What is it that you've got there?
Hmm, this looks like a new type of sea salt. This needs to be analyzed immediately!
Lead Strina the Fierce out of the Meteorite Mine and report her rescue to Karina Merinova.

Many of the miners lick the salt around here to relax, help them sleep better, and have a good time. But recently someone brought the miners salt in those pretty little cubes. They gave samples out for free so most of them took it. Then they started to forget everything, sleep for days, and walk around with huge smiles like complete idiots.
And then... then they went mad. They became extremely agitated and started attacking everyone. All my friends - those who didn't suck on those cubes - they all died. I thought I was going to be next, and I was so afraid. And then out came these undead. I'm alive thanks to them!
So... is this... magic? I'm an Orc, and I did... magic? How is that possible? ...What? I'm a descendant of the Legendary Orc? I have inherited magical talent? Are you serious?
I guess what you say must be true... If you help me get out of here, I'll go straight to the Supreme Chief. It doesn't matter whether I like it or not, he is the head of our people and I have a duty to do. Just please, help me get out of this mine!
You should stop by and see the overseer after you get out. I'm sure she'll want to know what's going on too.
What led to this uprising? How will I be able to write a report on all this? For the love of Nezeb... hmm.
What? Well, it's good that there's another survivor. But there's still a heap of problems to deal with!
Obtain 2 Dry Gargoyle Horns at the Cimmerian Ziggurat and 2 Sandy Spider Carapaces near the Meteorite Mine for Sarang Eshe.

Most creatures that live in the Dead Sea must wonder about that strange dome every day. I don't know how the people at Laguna Boil take care of this, but we choose to spread gossip to fool people! We say that the dome is a terribly dangerous natural phenomenon, and if you come too close, it'll suck you into oblivion! In time all gossip, even the most improbable, loses its appeal.
That's why we're planning to spread a new story about aliens from the other side of Astral. We'll say that they're intelligent creatures and more terrifying than the demons! They travel in flying saucepans, and we'll say that one of them crashed right here in the middle of the desert! And these domes are their secret bases where they carry out devious experiments! You can't imagine how easily the local savages will believe this junk.
But first we need to pour some oil onto the gossip's fire. Bring me spider carapaces and gargoyle horns. You can find the spiders near the Meteorite Mine. The gargoyles are near the Cimmerian Ziggurat to the northwest from here. I only need a few.
I can use those to make some very convincing props...
The crazier the gossip, the more people want to believe it. Everyone wants to hear something juicy. Silly creatures...
Here's the reward for your help. Now I need to make some preparations before we can set these things up.
Examine 4 Ancient Zem Sarcophagi and return to Sarang Eshe.

Listen, I hope we're friends now after all the work we've done together. Can I ask you to do me a personal favor? I want you to go to a structure in the northern part of the Dead Sea called the Cimmerian Ziggurat.
It's a bad place for those who are afraid of death, for it's all that's left of a very ancient city. It was built by the Zem long before this place was an ocean, and before it was flooded it was a place full of life!
For hundreds of years the majestic, dead buildings sat under the water. Now the sea is gone again, but the city still remains.
The strange thing is that none of its citizens have come back to life. Perhaps the sarcophagi are all empty? I would really appreciate it if you went up there and took a look at them. And... you don't have to tell the director about this. Do we understand each other?
I wonder if there are any of my fellow Zem there...
They're empty? Ah, the Zem must have died a very long time ago, so long ago that their bodies have turned to dust. It's sad news, but thank you for your help.
Find the body of Ogrom the Rowdy near the Cimmerian Ziggurat.

Hey you! Mind helping me out? You haven't seen my friend, have you? He's an Orcish hunter, a big brawny guy that goes by the name of Ogrom. We came here to hunt gargoyles together. It's very dangerous but very profitable. One good season can make you enough gold to live on for the rest of your life.
A few days ago he left early in the morning to scout the dunes, but he never came back. I suspect... the worst. In fact, I'm almost positive that he's met a grisly end. Every night I have visions of him in my dreams and he begs me to save him, to free him. What could that mean?
If he died, why didn't his soul eventually return to his body from Purgatory? Was it dismembered, or did something terrible happen to his soul? Or maybe these nightmares mean I'm simply going mad? I beg you, please look for him.
Looks like this is Ogrom the Rowdy!
He's definitely dead. You better return to Solka with the news. Wait... what's this?
Find the Servant of the Light near the Cimmerian Ziggurat.

To die while hunting is an honorable death for an Orc. I am not ashamed of my end, and if my body was destroyed I would happily remain in Purgatory.
The problem is, I should be able to return to it! It's mostly intact, but for some reason my efforts to resurrect always fail. On top of that, I can't even get into Purgatory. I'm stuck here! I've even resorted to harassing my companions in their dreams to get them to help me. But it seems that all they sent was a useless traveler.
Look, I know there's a disciple of the church somewhere around here. One of those lovely Servants of the Light. Can you find her and tell her my plight? If anyone can help me, she can!

The soul of the dead hunter? Yes, I know, he visited me in my dreams as well. He begged for help, covered with the blood of innocent animals. Ugh! Well, I suppose I'll help him anyway. I think I know why his soul is stuck the way it is.
Kill 4 Shifting Shadows near the Cimmerian Ziggurat, then return to Irina Zelenskaya.

I noticed this a while ago - the stream of souls here has dried up! There used to be a flood of them coming to this passage. Think about it - the Dead Sea's not a pleasure park! People here die like flies.
And then, suddenly, it was as though everyone stopped getting killed. It was then that those horrible black shadows appeared. I have a gut feeling that these two facts are related. What if... what if you tried to kill some of those shadows? Perhaps then the problem would fix itself?
So, do the shadows have anything to do with this or not? We'll find out the truth when they're destroyed.
Hm, I don't think that fixed the problem yet. It appears that the souls are still stuck.
Find out the situation at the nearest Stygian Passage.

I don't understand this. Maybe the black shadows appeared in other places as well? Until the root of this evil is dispelled, dozens of souls will remain trapped in limbo!
There are two other passages in the Dead Sea apart from mine. This closest one is... well, I can't say where. But maybe you'll happen to stumble across the place in your travels! Let's just say it's to the north along the coast. May the Light bless your path!

Hello. I'm this passage's new Servant of the Light! Thankfully I haven't had to deal with any deaths yet. It's such a relief. Black shadows? Yes, there are some here around here. They really scared me a couple of night ago!
Report Crowka's story to Alexey Sinitsyn.

Ugh! What happened to me? How did I get here? And why am I dead?!
I can't remember things very well, my memory is so foggy. Let me see. I remember running wildly around the mine... and I think there was a pick in my hand and... I killed someone... oh, it's all so blurry!
I think I remember something about... Nezeb! Something to do with the great Nezeb. Maybe there was a political speech before I died? I also remember there was a goblin in the mine.
Yes, there was definitely a goblin. He brought us some unusual salt cubes. All of the miners were grabbing it. Oh, I wish I could remember more!

So, what do we have?
Goblins collect the salt, goblins are sabotaging the construction, and it was a goblin that brought the salt in cubes into the mine?
All clues are pointing to those wretched beasts being allied with Korleone!
Offer a deal to Boros the Brazen in Pridonsk. Bring 4 pieces of Hermit Crab Meat to Boros the Brazen.

It's time to visit Pridonsk, the home of the Freeborn. The Freeborn are made up of a bunch of different species, most of them extremely savage. It's a haven for all dregs of society, so I'm sure those goblins have a base there.
Go there and pretend to be a messenger from the capital. You shall say you're working for a crime boss that wants to import the sea salt to Nezebgrad, and ask them who they you should meet to set things up. I think it's a great story, especially since I know you've already had dealings with the underground of Nezebgrad. You'll play the role well.
When you get there, the one you should find first is a minotaur. I hear he is their current leader. Of course you shouldn't visit with empty hands. Collect some crab meat on the way there - I'm sure the gift will soften him up. Good luck!

I have listened carefully to your story, and if that is what you want I shall help you. I will organize communications between you and the right goblins, but there are things you must do for my people first.
First you need to prove that you deserve our attention. We only help those that love freedom and have a strong and proud nature. Got it?
Plant 4 Alien Scarecrows along the road to Pridonsk and report to Sarang Eshe.

Ok, I have made several scarecrows from the carapaces and the horns. Our target audience is the citizens of Pridonsk. All gossip that starts there quickly becomes embroidered with new details, and then it gets spread all over the Dead Sea as though it were fact.
There is a road that goes from here all the way to Pridonsk, and I ask that you plant these scarecrows all along the path. Perhaps when seen up close they don't look like scary monsters from beyond the Astral, but the citizens won't come within ten yards of them! That I know for a fact.
Then they'll stay far away from the dome for at least a year, and we'll be able to continue our operations in peace. Ah, what a great plan this is!
I've already asked Rodion if there's gossip going around about the aliens yet. For now he's heard nothing.
So, are all the scarecrows planted? Well done! Soon there will be a flood of gossip, just you wait.
Post 4 notices around Pridonsk and return to Jukat the Nomadic.

There's no doubt about it, the Freeborn are to blame. They're a group of all sorts of rabble - goblins, satyrs, tons of mischievous creatures! They have to be working with the mafia, and they should have been put in their place a long time ago!
Unfortunately we were ordered not to interfere with any matters that aren't proven to be part of the salt trafficking. Even then, we must keep our true identities a secret. In other words, we don't exist and we must let the Freeborn believe they are the bosses of the seabed.
I guess the Council knows what's best, but I think I can figure out a way to bend the rules a little. Let's do it like this.
Take these notices from Lieutenant Bodrin. Listen to what they say. "The Imperial is looking for anyone who has information, rumors, or even thoughts about who, when, how, or for what reason construction is going on to the east of the Mana Station. They will be well rewarded for their help."
Post them up around the Freeborn headquarters at Pridonsk. If any of them take the bait and report to Bodrin with information, we'll know straight away that they've been hanging around the salt flats to the south. That will prove their guilt!

I know this idea will work wonderfully!
I just hope those mongrels can read.

Guess what? Rodion has reported the first trickle of information. Some waterfolk woman is convinced that her husband does damage to the equipment near Sector 05 in the night. Except she believes that he takes the neighbor's wife there, too... Aren't these people weak in the head?
Go to the jaws of the ancient sea creature to the east and report to Boros the Brazen if you survive.

In the desert there lives a giant sand worm named Hai'shulud. They say he's hundreds of years old and Xadaganians, Orcs, and Arisen all live in fear of him. Only the Freeborn are able to avoid his wrath, for we are wise enough to sense him before he strikes.
His lair is just to the east of Pridonsk, beneath the jaws of an ancient sea creature. Go there and bang on the giant skull. This will disrupt his rest and he'll angrily come forth from the sands. If you are truly strong, you'll be able to defeat him and claim victory over the desert.
This is your test. If you pass it, you will earn the respect of the Freeborn. Then we can talk business.
You again? How... How did you manage to survive?
Yes, it was the Freeborn that ambushed you! Anyone who wants to trade that sea salt deserves to die!
Gather 4 Lizardman Amulets and bring them to Vladimir Udalov.

Hello! It's rare to meet someone here apart from the normal outcasts. I am an ethnographer, and my specialty is studying the cultures of savage minorities in Sarnaut.
My biggest interest is the oasis to the northeast of here. Thousands of years ago it was an island populated by the waterfolk. They lived a peaceful existence for many years until the Great Cataclysm occurred.
Then the water receded, and from the bottom of the ocean came savage lizardmen. Then they forced out the waterfolk and took the place for themselves.
They don't look it, but those lizardmen are actually a very intelligent race. However, they're also very aggressive and... not very well researched. No scientist has yet managed to assimilate into their collective... herd... pack? Hmm, I need to think about the correct terminology.
I haven't managed to do that either - in fact I barely managed to escape the oasis with my life! However, I did notice they wear strange amulets around their necks. It would be excellent if I could get my hands on some of those. That would be a great place to begin my studies! If you're heading that way, could you please get me some?
Perhaps the lizardmen are in their mating season and that's why they're so aggressive? Maybe I should visit them at another time of year.
Oh, I can't wait to study these! Thank you! Thank you very, very much!
Kill 4 Sand Lizard Warriors and return to Ocha the Enduring.

That scientist is a complete amateur, don't listen to any of his stories! Can you believe he claims my people have enuresis? We just sweat a lot, especially when the night is hot in this damnable desert. That smartass, he probably has enuresis himself.
I'll have you know that we've been living here like civilized people for a long time now. We even have a school. This is a real town, not some cave in the forest! Ugh.
What he said about those lizardmen is true though. I hate them so much! We should be living in that oasis now, next to a brook full of fresh clear water...
That's the most beautiful place on the entire seabed, you know. Centuries have passed, yet we've never been able to defeat the savage beasts. So please, I ask you from my heart - kill as many of those damn lizardmen as you can.

May they all turn to dust, those stupid bipedal lizards!
They didn't even want to ally with us Freeborn, can you believe that?
If we could get more heroes like you here, perhaps one day those lizardmen could be eradicated and we would be able to make our home there. Far away as possible from those asinine scientists...
Kill Goldgobbler and return to Pika the Outcast.

Do you want to make a deal with an old kobold? First you must swear that you won't cheat! Hey, who swears like that?! You must stand on one leg. No, no, no, your right leg! Hold your left ear in your right hand. Yes, just like that! And say "I swear!" Alright, that's good. I trust you now.
Listen closely. Near the Tangled Knoll there is an ancient ship wreck. Its hold is full of gold and shiny stones - they'll sell for a fortune! If that's all there was to it I could go get the treasure myself, but there's one big problem.
In the ship's hold lives an enooormous gar, a beast this old kobold has named Goldgobbler. He attacks anyone that tries to get to the ship. So this is our deal - you kill the monster, and then you bring me back the treasure. In exchange I'll give you a few coins.
But if you keep the treasure for yourself, this kobold will find you anywhere you go and lock you up in an empty treasure chest! Forever! And there you will rot. So do we have a deal?
The treasure belongs to me, because all treasures in the world belong to the kobolds! Oh yes!

What, there was no gold in the ship? How can you say that to a kobold! Kobolds can see gold through walls - it doesn't matter if they're wooden or stone. I know there was some there! Here, take this coin anyway. And you can keep that silly globe as well. Now go!
Bring the Strange Glass Orb to Sarang Eshe.

All that was in the chest was this strange glass orb. It doesn't look like a treasure the kobold would appreciate. It's more like some magical artifact. Maybe you should show it to Sarang Eshe at the Seventh Seabed Resort.
You were right to bring this to me. This is definitely a magical artifact.
Well, why are you standing there? Do you expect me to tell you what it is this instant? I need time to study it. Lots of time!
Find Jackboot the Bloodthirsty at the Mana Station.

There is a large mana station to the southeast of here. An old friend of mine who goes by the name of Jackboot works there as a guard. He is part of the Bloodthirsty clan, and we were neighbors for a long time back in the Wild Isles. It's been quite a while since I've heard from him, though.
If you aren't busy and you get bored at our resort, maybe you can take a stroll down there and find Jackboot. Check up on how he's doing and see if he needs any help. And just between you and me, he's a little slow. I worry about him.

Yes? ...What! You're here to see me? Did Jukat send you? He's just like my mom, I swear! What could possibly happen to me here?
Tell him Jackboot is doing fine. Well, almost...
Find Solka the Unyielding near the Cimmerian Ziggurat.

My job has taught me to keep my eyes open and notice everything that goes on around me. With work like ours, we cannot afford to take risks! An overlooked clue could mean failure or worse, death.
A short time ago I noticed a couple of Orcish hunters heading in the direction of the Cimmerian Ziggurat. Hunting is a noble sport, and I have nothing against it. But for goodness sake, what's there to hunt over there? Gargoyles? It all seemed very suspicious.
In short, I'm asking you to go there and find those hunters. I just received information back from the capital, and after some digging they discovered that one of them is named Solka the Unyielding. Find her and ask her what she's doing there with her friend.
Hey you, traveler! Mind helping out a fellow Imperial citizen?
Talk to Sarang Eshe in the Seventh Seabed Resort.

Sarang Eshe is a wonderful woman. We owe a great deal to her brilliant mind! She meets all the challenges and never hesitates to use all available resources in the interests of the common cause.

But what she is lacking is a person she can fully trust. I can see that something is eating her. She wants to ask something but her sense of duty doesn't let her speak to us.

It seems like you two have already found common ground. Try hanging around her more often. Maybe she will reach for your help. Whatever her request is, do it. Don't report to me or to anyone else.
Oh... I'm glad you are here. Don't get me wrong, but I've been thinking about you.

Here you go.
And remember, when we find my father, you and I fight the same battle.
Uncover the plans of the goblins on the Northern Sand Bar.

Did you hear about Lican's gang? They settled on the Northern Bank and are collaborating with the mafia. In other words, they're dirty criminals! And, as it befits their sort, they are hatching some plan. We need to know what it is.
So, is the task clear? I don't care what you do to get it done. You can pretend to be a bush and try and listen to their conversations for all I care. Or you can press Lican directly - that's probably the most effective method if you ask me. It's your choice, but find out what that gang is planning!
Ugh, these goblins. I've never liked them!
I see! I knew those scumbags were planning something! Now we'll deal with them properly!
Bring 5 Giant Vulture feathers to Ocha the Enduring.

Hello there! Welcome to Pridonsk, one of the most beautiful villages in the Dead Sea. In fact, it's one of the only villages in the Dead Sea. And on top of that, all of the other settlements are either restricted to Imperial citizens only, or full of depraved vagabonds like those despicable lizardmen!
You would do well to gain our favor, you know. We're a pretty powerful force out here in the desert. And you're in luck because I have quite a bit of influence around here. Oh, yes I do! It just so happens that if you help me out with a few things, you'll be welcomed by the whole village in no time.
I see that you're listening now. Good. Then bring me back one of my favorite things - feathers! The common ones that most of those mangy birds have won't do. I must have the largest, glossiest feather in the whole desert! The giant vultures that live near Baladur Port should have just what I'm after. They're formidable opponents, yes, but I'll make your efforts well worth it.
Have you got the feathers yet?
They are absolutely beautiful! Even more beautiful than I imagined! Thank you so much!
Find Sika the Nimble in Saltern.

Oh dear, I'm done with. I will be put to prison, that's for sure. Or even sentenced to death. Regardless I've done all I could... Oh, why, you're the eye-witness! You will confirm it, right? Will you?
What do you mean, confirm to who? To this orcish lady, Sika the Nimble, of course. She said if I am clean, there's nothing to fear... and then she just left... Well, I am clean as a whistle!
Save me! Please! Find Sika the Nimble and tell her everything!
Greetings! Tell Merinova nobody's blaming her. We've got enough on our plate.
Bring 4 Drops of Salt Water to Solka the Unyielding at the Cimmerian Ziggurat.

I have another favor to ask you. To the north of here some water elementals live near a few small lakes. I once overheard some scientists in the Hadron quarter talking about them. They were saying they desperately needed their special water - salty and full of magic. They said it would make a good... ca... ca-ta-lyst.
I've no idea what that means, but it must be pretty valuable. That water must be all that remains from the once great ocean! I don't know how it got turned into those great beasts, but it has to be full of magic. Those eggheads would just love the stuff!
How about this - you go hunt those elementals and bring me some of their water, and then I'll ship it off to those scientists. Remember you still need my help in this because I'm the only one who knows exactly who they are, hehe! In return I'll give you a hefty sum of money.
Aha, there they are! Here's your reward. Not enough? Remember I'm taking a huge risk here! Maybe I won't score anything for these drops!
Find the 4 Stones of the Dead Sea and report back to anthropologist Vladimir Lychkin.

To be able to call oneself a true scholar, one must be really aware of one's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed four stones imbued with magic around the Dead Sea. Explore this great area, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the Mana Station, Northern Sand Bar, Geyser Pools, and the Meteorite Mine. Good luck, traveler.
What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.
Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!
Gather the treasure from the sands.

Hm, this trunk doesn't look like an antique with powerful artifacts of the past. It seems to be a soldiers' trunk that was abandoned here after a fight or some other accident. This is pretty sad, but above all, it means... the trunk has no owner! Yet...
Now the chest has a new master! So what that it's not a rare artifact. I'm sure it has something useful!
Find the hidden treasure to the south and report your success to Alexey Sinitsyn.

The sands out there are almost as dangerous as the beasts, as I'm sure you noticed! If it wasn't for this dome, the dunes would cover this area in a matter of weeks. Most of the other settlements have to shovel the stuff out on a daily basis.
That means that there's a whole bunch of treasure out there that no one's discovered! Some poor traveler drops a cache of stuff and the sands swallow it up. A few years later, the winds blow a certain way and there it is again, basking in the light of day!
In fact, I thought I saw a large chest myself while I was taking a stroll the other day. I was in a hurry, and I figured it might have been a trick of the light, but if you've got time on your hands maybe you should go look for it. I think it was off to the south.
Smile, smile, what a great day! Oh, it's you!
Wow, look at that! So there was a chest there after all! Well, I'm sure that reward was well-deserved.
Bring 20 average potions of Proficiency to Boros the Brazen in Pridonsk to improve your reputation with the Freeborn.

Want to be a friend to the Freeborn?

Hrm... OK, I'll tell you how to do it.

We need average potions of Proficiency. As you know, the Imperial Suppliers don't deliver their goods to us, while life in the sands of the Dead Sea is full of hardships. Therefore, those potions are as precious as gold or water. Bring me 5 such potions. And then just keep 'em coming! Eventually I'll announce to all the Freeborn that you're our friend!
If you have the potions, you're a friend. If you don't, get lost!

Thanks...
Being a friend to the Freeborn doesn't come cheap! But you're on the right track!
Obtain 4 Mutant Eyes at the Mana Station and bring them to Feodora Nosova.

As I'm sure you noticed, a lot of really weird monsters have recently started spawning along the coast to the north. I'm pretty sure it's due to all of the radiation leaking from the Mana Station. We recently turned the power up beyond the recommended limits, and the kind of radiation that could produce could mutate anything!
A screw up of this magnitude could easily get everyone at this plant fired. My coworker over there things that we should destroy the evidence as quickly as possible. I, however, have a better idea! You see, we could simply pretend that this whole debacle was intentional! I'm sure those Arisen scientists would just love to know how to replicate what happened here.
If you could gather twenty of their eyes and bring them to me, I could send a whole shipment off to the ZIT Headquarters immediately. Then that would mean a promotion for sure! Do this for me and I'll reward you for your efforts.
Do you have the eyes yet? I know it's slimy work, but it would save everyone here at the mana station!
These look great! I can just imagine those scientists dancing with glee as they gaze upon these eyes.
Kill 4 Searing Eyes in the western part of the Mana Station, then report to Arina Struzhkina.

Have you seen those horrible creatures flying along the shore to the north? They're absolutely terrifying! I don't know what they are, but I do know that they only started appearing within the last couple of weeks.
Oh no, I wonder if it had to do with... Uh oh. Hmm, I don't suppose you could help out a fellow Imperial citizen? I would really, really appreciate it!
You see, we recently turned up the voltage here at the Mana Station. The head honchos over at the XAES kept complaining that we didn't supply them enough energy. We had no choice - it was either push the station to its limits or get demoted! All of the radiation around through those pipes must have created them. I guess there's nothing for it but to turn the power back down. We don't want any more of those monstrosities spawning.
I'm sure I can convince my bosses that supplying more energy just isn't possible, but I don't know how I can explain those monsters away. Maybe if you can kill them all, no one will be the wiser!
Well? Has the deed been done?
Phew, you really saved me! It took me ten years to reach this position - I would be crushed if I was fired!
Kill Deathgazer and report to Arina Struzhkina.

You did a really great job just now, and I do appreciate it! But I have one more favor to ask. You see, there is one monster in particular that is quite huge. If the inspectors are bound to notice any of the creatures, it's that one!
If you could go back up to the coast and destroy it. I would be really really grateful! Even more grateful than I am right now! And when I finally get promoted to head of the XAES, I'll remember what you did for me, I promise! So... you're going to go up there and exterminate him now, right?
I know I'm asking a lot, but this is extremely important! Please kill the thing!
Oh, I can't tell you how relieved I am! Ever since I figured out that those horrible creatures were created by the station, I haven't been able to stop worrying. Now I can finally relax!
Bring 4 Elemental Bracers to Pika the Outcast in Pridonsk.

Fine. So Goldgobbler doesn't have the treasure. But Pika the Outcast knows where you can find some. Pika the Outcast is a Kobold, and Kobolds know everything.
Have you ever seen air elementals? I have. They have special bracelets! Do you know what they're made of? Pure gold!
Bring me four of these bracelets, alright? You can find the elementals to the west of Laguna Boil. There are evil humans there, so I can't do it myself. But you can. Don't come back without the bracelets!
Gold, gold, gold! There's nothing in the world better than gold!
Give them here! Ah, this is exactly what I was after. I love the feel of gold against my skin... Here's your coin, now leave me to enjoy myself.
Kill 4 Gusty Elementals to the west of Laguna Boil. Report to Boros the Brazen.

You're a real hero! You freed our people! Incredible!
Perhaps you'll help me with something else? To the northwest of here are tons of air elementals. They viciously strike at anyone they see. They are really dangerous, and I'm afraid of them. But Boros the Brazen wants me to kill them. No idea why. So I'm begging you, please help me. Kill four elementals. Please!
Then report to Boros the Brazen. That should please him.
Yes? You better have something important to report. I am not one for idle chatter.
Good work! Those air elementals are a huge nuisance, always whipping up sand into peoples' faces. You're proving to be a more useful ally than expected!
Kill Visash and bring Visash's Head to Alexey Sinitsyn.

Hey, I've got a little secret to tell you. I recently discovered an old cook book full of Dead Sea recipes. And the best thing about it is that it was written by pirates! That means it didn't have all of those crappy muffin recipes - it had instructions on how to make booze!
Unfortunately, most of the recipes call for ingredients that have been extinct for hundreds of years. Except, possibly, one. You see, I hear that there's one lone hydra that still roams the desert. The locals call him Visash, and he's supposed to be huge!
That's just perfect, because that means I can get as much brain juice out of him as possible. Yes, brain juice! That's what the recipe calls for - nothing else will do. Now bring me his head so I can squeeze some out!
Well, do you have the head? I know it's a hard task, but trust me, it'll be worth it!
Oh boy! It's huge! Bigger than I imagined! I can make tons of booze with this. You'll be the first to know when my creation is complete!
Kill 4 Ravenous Hyenas and report to Yuri Boklov.

You have to be really careful around here. You can encounter dangerous animals everywhere. Hyenas, for example.
They came here from the prairies of the Igsh Military District, acting like this is their territory. They keep breeding, and it disrupts the... ecological balance!
We need to reduce their numbers a little. There is a reward: five silver coins per hyena. How does that sound? Just don't turn this into the Great Hunt! I kill these hyenas myself on occasion. Why? It's good money!
I'll allow you to kill four hyenas. Should be enough. And wouldn't be a big loss. Hehe.
Well, have the mangy scoundrels been given a good beating?

Here's your reward. Of course, I'll take a part of it for myself - after all, I supervised, so I should be paid too! Just don't tell anyone! Or more hunters will show up!
And you gotta be wise about it! We don't want them to kill them all.
Kill Sandsnarl and return to Yuri Boklov.

There's one particular hyena that's giving us trouble here at Dry Waters. The guards have nicknamed him Sandsnarl, and whenever they hear his growl they go running!
He's the biggest, meanest, ugliest hyena you'll ever see! Not that most of them aren't ugly, but this one's a doozy! Probably all of that digging around in trash cans and rotten corpses warped his ugly mug.
He also seems to be the leader of the hyena pack. He leads the charge, and when he decides that he's had his fill they all clear out of here. I'm pretty sure that if you got rid of him those hyenas would learn to fear us pretty quickly.
He's sure to live in the canyon to the north of here with the rest of the brutes. I'm sure a veteran like you won't have any problem taking him down. If you manage to finish him off, come see me and I'll give you a reward.
All of the guards cower in fear when they see Sandsnarl prowling around here.
Amazing! If we had a leader like you instead of Lieutenant Bodrin, things would sure be a lot better around here! Here's your promised reward - don't spend it all in one place!
Participate in killing the Skeletal Desecrator and report to Karina Merinova.

The miners' rebellion is absolutely horrible. The thing is, this place has a pretty high turnover rate anyway, so I'm not too worried about replacing all the workers. Then, just when I thought it couldn't get any worse, I heard something even more awful!
One of the survivors said that the mine is full of skeletons! I doubt that they'll quietly return to the earth on their own, so someone is going to need to go in there and destroy them.
I suppose I could get the Imperial soldiers to kill most of the skeletons after the miners are cleared out, but we have so few of them around here. I'm also not sure if they'd be able to deal with such a serious threat.
Can you go down there and eliminate any skeleton that looks like their leader? With the biggest one gone, the army will have a better chance. I'll reward you handsomely!
What a pain all of this has been! Insane miners, eerie skeletons! I don't get paid enough!
Great, that's one less problem I have to deal with! Now choose your reward quickly - I need to finish this report!
